titulo: Documentação API SNGPC - Sistema Nacional de Gerenciamento de Produtos Controlados
conteudo:
POST /v1/Authentication/GetToken

As credenciais para geração do token da API (v1/Authentication/GetToken) são as mesmas utilizadas pelos usuários para fazer login no Sistema SNGPC WEB

Filtros disponíveis:

Nome Tipo Descrição Exemplo
username string usuário –
password string senha –

Exemplos de chamada:

CURL:

curl -X POST \
  '{{sngpcUrl}}/v1/Authentication/GetToken' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "username": "string",
    "password": "string"
  }'

HTTP:

POST /v1/Authentication/GetToken HTTP/1.1
Host: {{sngpcUrl}}
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "username": "string",
  "password": "string"
}

POST /v1/FileXml/EnviarArquivoXmlSNGPC

Enviar Arquivo Xml SNGPC

Filtros disponíveis:

Nome Tipo Descrição Exemplo
xml string XML de requisição –

Exemplos de chamada:

CURL:

# Enviando arquivo local (recomendado)
curl -X POST \
  '{{sngpcUrl}}/v1/FileXml/EnviarArquivoXmlSNGPC' \
  -H 'accept: text/plain' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' \
  --data-binary @arquivo.xml

# Ou inline (atenção ao escaping)
curl -X POST \
  '{{sngpcUrl}}/v1/FileXml/EnviarArquivoXmlSNGPC' \
  -H 'accept: text/plain' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' \
  --data-binary '<xml>...</xml>'

HTTP:

POST /v1/FileXml/EnviarArquivoXmlSNGPC HTTP/1.1
Host: {{sngpcUrl}}
Accept: text/plain
Content-Type: application/xml

<xml>...</xml>

GET /v1/FileXml/ConsultaDadosArquivoXml/{email}/{cnpj}/{hash}

Consulta Dados Arquivo Xml SNGPC

Filtros disponíveis:

Nome Tipo Descrição Exemplo
email string E-mail exemplo@dominio.com
cnpj string CNPJ 12345678000190
hash string Hash abc123hash

Exemplos de chamada:

CURL:

curl \
  '{{sngpcUrl}}/v1/FileXml/ConsultaDadosArquivoXml/exemplo%40dominio.com/12345678000190/abc123hash' \
  -H 'accept: text/plain'

HTTP:

GET /v1/FileXml/ConsultaDadosArquivoXml/exemplo%40dominio.com/12345678000190/abc123hash HTTP/1.1
Host: {{sngpcUrl}}
Accept: text/plain

XSD sngpc.xsd 

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="iso-8859-1" ?>

<schema xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:sngpc="urn:sngpc-schema"
    targetNamespace="urn:sngpc-schema" elementFormDefault="qualified">
  <include schemaLocation="sngpcSimpleTypes.xsd" />
  <include schemaLocation="sngpcComplexTypes.xsd" />
  <include schemaLocation="sngpcOperacoes.xsd" />
  <!-- Definicao da mensagem -->
  <element name="mensagemSNGPC" type="sngpc:ct_msgMovimentacao" />
  <element name="mensagemSNGPCInventario" type="sngpc:ct_msgInventario" />

  <complexType name="ct_msgMovimentacao">
    <sequence>
      <element name="cabecalho" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="1">
        <complexType>
          <sequence>
            <element name="cnpjEmissor" type="sngpc:st_CNPJ" />
            <element name="cpfTransmissor" type="sngpc:st_CPF" />
            <element name="dataInicio" type="sngpc:st_data" />
            <element name="dataFim" type="sngpc:st_data" />
          </sequence>
        </complexType>
      </element>
      <element name="corpo" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="1">
        <complexType>
          <sequence>
            <element name="medicamentos">
              <complexType>
                <sequence>
                  <element name="entradaMedicamentos" type="sngpc:ct_EntradaMedicamento" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaMedicamentoVendaAoConsumidor" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaMedicamentoVendaAoConsumidor" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaMedicamentoTransferencia" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaMedicamentoTransferencia" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaMedicamentoPerda" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaMedicamentoPerda" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="entradaMedicamentoTransformacao" type="sngpc:ct_EntradaMedicamentoTransformacao" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaMedicamentoTransformacaoVendaAoConsumidor" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaMedicamentoTransformacaoVendaAoConsumidor" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaMedicamentoTransformacaoPerda" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaMedicamentoTransformacaoPerda" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                </sequence>
              </complexType>
            </element>
            <element name="insumos">
              <complexType>
                <sequence>
                  <element name="entradaInsumos" type="sngpc:ct_EntradaInsumo" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaInsumoVendaAoConsumidor" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaInsumoVenda" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaInsumoTransferencia" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaInsumoTransferencia" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                  <element name="saidaInsumoPerda" type="sngpc:ct_SaidaInsumoPerda" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" />
                </sequence>
              </complexType>
            </element>
          </sequence>
        </complexType>
      </element>
    </sequence>
  </complexType>

  <complexType name="ct_msgInventario">
    <sequence>
      <element name="cabecalho" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="1">
        <complexType>
          <sequence>
            <element name="cnpjEmissor" type="sngpc:st_CNPJ" />
            <element name="cpfTransmissor" type="sngpc:st_CPF" />

XSD sngpcOperacoes.xsd 


  <?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1" ?>

<schema xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:sngpc="urn:sngpc-schema"
    targetNamespace="urn:sngpc-schema" elementFormDefault="qualified">
  <!-- Schema com os tipos simples importados do TISS -->
  <simpleType name="st_classeTerapeutica">
    <restriction base="string">
      <!--Antimicrobiano-->
      <enumeration value="1" />
      <!--Sujeito a controle Especial-->
      <enumeration value="2" />
    </restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_data">
    <restriction base="date"></restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_CPF">
    <restriction base="string">
      <!-- O tamanho Mínimo também deve ser 11 -->
      <!-- <minLength value="0" />  -->
      <minLength value="11" />
      <maxLength value="11" />
      <whiteSpace value="collapse" />
      <pattern value="\d{11}"></pattern>
    </restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_CNPJ">
    <restriction base="string">
      <!-- O Tamanho mínimo deve também ser 14 -->
      <minLength value="14" />
      <maxLength value="14" />
      <pattern value="\d{14}" />
    </restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_RazaoSocial">
    <restriction base="string">
      <maxLength value="100" />
    </restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_AES">
    <restriction base="string">
      <minLength value="3" />
      <maxLength value="3" />
      <pattern value="[0-9]{3}" />
    </restriction>
  </simpleType>
  <simpleType name="st_simNao">
